description: This file defines a class 'TalkSystemSpeechSynthesizer' that manages text-to-speech synthesis, using AVFoundation's AVSpeechSynthesizer to speak given text, handle timeouts, and control speech. It provides functions to speak text asynchronously, stop speaking, and manages internal state and delegate callbacks.

classes.name: TalkSystemSpeechSynthesizer
classes.description: A singleton class managing speech synthesis, providing async speaking with timeout handling and delegate callbacks.

classes.name: SpeakError
classes.description: An error enum indicating speech cancellation.

methods.name: speak
methods.description: Asynchronously speaks the provided text, with optional language and start callback, implementing a watchdog timeout.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops ongoing speech and cancels the watchdog timeout.

methods.name: watchdogTimeoutSeconds
methods.description: Calculates speech duration estimates per language and applies a timeout multiplier.

methods.name: matchesCurrentUtterance
methods.description: Checks if the given utterance ID matches the current utterance being spoken.

methods.name: handleFinish
methods.description: Handles the completion or cancellation of speech, resolving the continuation accordingly.

methods.name: finishCurrent
methods.description: Resets internal state after speech finishes or is canceled.
